profile.description: GCP c4a-highcpu-32 / Axion Neoverse-V2, parakeet-tdt_ctc-110m, OFFLINE (REST) only. This runtime refuses to stream this model, so the question is throughput and not concurrent real-time streams. Nothing here has been measured yet.

server.why_not_streaming: mynah_asr_stream_unsupported() refuses this pack on three counts read from the weights and the config: it has linear biases (use_bias), it folds a batch_norm into the conv module where the streaming step applies layer_norm, and it uses symmetric conv padding where the streaming step is causal-only. The server asks the same function before the WebSocket upgrade and declines with that reason. This is not a tuning gap.

MYNAH_ASR_THREADS.why: must be ABSENT: the pool sizes itself from the affinity mask.

MYNAH_ASR_CAPS.why: must be ABSENT: the runtime probe chooses the kernel and dispatch_required checks it.

gates.notes: The streaming gates do not apply to a model that cannot stream. The offline gates are xRT against a stated wall and per-request p95; neither has a threshold yet because neither has a measurement.

notes: An earlier REST ladder on this box reported ~19 xRT for this profile and it is WITHDRAWN: the server it measured was the Nemotron one from the previous phase, which had never been killed and still held the port. No valid Parakeet number exists on this host.
The only honest datum so far is offline RTF 0.024 for this pack on the development Mac against 0.682 for Nemotron int8 -- a development signal, and a ratio rather than a capacity.

Expected shape, to be confirmed rather than assumed: 98.0 M encoder MACs per frame against Nemotron's 553.6 M (5.65x less) and a joint head 12.8x cheaper. Where that lands on an Arm box with our own f32 GEMM is exactly what has not been measured.
